lines.en: label day318:
scene thisiswar1
: I don’t get it...
: What part? What aren’t you getting?
: The part with all the words.
: Uta, you need to help me so I can help you.
: I can’t teach you the words if I don’t know the words that need to be taught.
scene thisiswar2
: Sensei! I am dumb! Please come help!
: You really think he’s going to do anything to help you in this situation?
: We’re still two of the newest girls in the[school] and even we should know that teaching is at the very bottom of his list of interests.
scene thisiswar3
: Ugh...stupid standardized test thingies...showing up out of nowhere and reminding us that we’re not all just cruisin’ by without havin’ to work for it.
: Hey, I’m totally down to help you. I just need to know a little more about what you’re struggling with.
Hello there.
As you can see, the class is hard at work today.
Though, some are finding a bit more success than others.
I actually don’t mind days like this, where the girls are suddenly hit with reminders through my faithful class representative that they can’t slack off every day-
Because that just means things will be quieter than normal.
When things are quieter than normal, I have an easier time sleeping through the[school] day.
And the sooner the[school] day ends, the sooner I can do the things I actually want to do.
IE: Not be in[school].
It’s a little weird how, even though I don’t do any teaching at all, it’s still mentally and physically draining being inside of this place.
I guess that’s just one of the effects[school] can have on the mind.
Regardless, I’m glad that things are slowing down today.
Here’s hoping that Uta figures out “the words” or whatever it is she’s struggling with.
scene thisiswar4
: Hey, what if we stop studying altogether and just guess on all of the answers for the thingy? I’m sure we can fail like one or two of those, right?
: I’m pretty sure we get held back if we fail any of them.
: Well then what the heck is the point of normal tests and normal grades if the standardy ones are the only ones that matter?
: You...do realize we haven’t taken a single “normal” test since we got here, right? They’re like, not even a thing anymore.
scene thisiswar5
: Life itself is a test, dearest Io.
: From the moment we are born to the moment we get cancer and die, every day is a test to see if we’re fit to survive.
: That’s cool. But if you’re not going to actually use it, can I have my notebook back?
: Right after you teach me the words.
scene thisiswar6
: I still don’t know what words you’re even talking about.
scene thisiswar7
: Well, well, well...It seems to me that someone could use a little pick me up.
scene thisiswar8
: I may be tiny, but I highly doubt even a skilled martial artist like yourself could just lift me up out of my chair, Ayane.
: So unless you plan on picking up my brain and replacing it with one that has more words, I think you’re better off just going back to your own seat.
: Actually, Uta...I was thinking now might be as good a time as any to begin Operation: Firestarter.
scene thisiswar9
: You want to burn the[school] down?! Right now?!
: Of course not. I’d be asking Ami for help if that were the case.
: That was so long ago! And it only happened once!
: See? She’s the only experienced arsonist in the class.
: Mmmmmmm...you sure about that?
: Please don’t plan to burn the[school] down.
: This place might suck, but I still rely on it to pay my bills.
: I suppose if Sensei doesn’t like the[school], there isn’t much stopping us from demolishing the place.
: I am ready when you are, Ayane.
scene thisiswar10
: Okay, you do remember what Operation: Firestarter actually is, right? Because we came up with it together.
: Course I remember. Do ya really think now is the best time, though?
: Absolutely not.
: I don’t know what you two are planning but-
: Actually, on second thought, what better time than now?
: Touka and Yasuyasu are finally startin’ to show some chemistry, so there’s nothin’ else holdin’ us back.
scene thisiswar11
: Hm? Did someone say Touka?
: Am I being included in [high_school] gossip? Is it good or bad?
: Please tell me.
: Fact is, even if we do fail our tests, we’ll still have fun in the process. So it will all be worth it in the long run.
: You should still study. Education is important and I’m only suggesting this since I’m kind of smart.
: You slimy bastard.
scene thisiswar12
: Okay. I don’t have to be involved. Please enjoy your conversation that may or may not be about me.
: You should probably be studying, Uta. You can’t really afford to goof off right now.
: Also, if you get held back, I won’t have anyone else to talk to and that would suck.
: Hey, the offer to hang out with Noriko and me is still-
: Please don’t talk to me. I’m studying.
: Ayane, I’m glad you chose today as the day to remind me that I don’t care about learning.
: That’s not really what I was-
: Because if there’s anything that’s going to motivate me to study harder, it’s not studying at all!
: Amen to that, Uta!
scene thisiswar13
: So, with that in mind...I believe it is time for us to begin phase one.
: Hostile takeover?
: Hostile takeover.
: Hostile what now?
: Ayane, if you’re still bringing guns to[school] after all of the incidents with the janitors, I’m going to have to step in and-
scene black
: Wait, what are you doing?
: Step aside, Sensei! This is our classroom now! Me and Ayane are about to blow your-
: Penis!
: Mind!
: Penis...mind?
: I wouldn't say they’re entirely wrong considering it is your mind, but I still can’t condone-
: Wait! What are you two doing?! Get your hands off of him!
scene thisiswar14
: You know, I was really hoping things were about to go in a different direction when I heard the “penis” thing, but-
: Nodoka.
: Yes?
: Now is not the time.
: I beg to differ, Sensei.
: Ayane, Uta...why am I sitting at this desk?
scene thisiswar15
: Because you’re about to be[school]ed, bitch.
: Excuse me?
: Don’t call my husband a bitch, Uta. Remember that his role in all of this is just as important as ours.
: Look at him, cozied up at a [high_school]er’s desk like he’s pretending to be [young]again.
: You literally pushed me here.
: So weak. So childish.
scene thisiswar16
: Okay, seriously. Stop.
: I’m sorry! I’m just gettin’ fired up thinking about how we’re going to be spending the next two days starting...RIGHT NOW! GO!
scene thisiswar17
: Students! Teacher! Molly!
: Why just Molly?! What did I do?!
: If you have been eavesdropping on my desperate pleas for help, first of all, shame on you!
: Second, you probably overheard a conversation about Ayane and me burning down the[school]!
: Do not fear! That will not be happening!
A scattered, awkward applause started by Rin quickly spreads throughout the classroom.
: But what we will do...is set a fire under your asses! For now is the time to get down and groovy!
Oh. I’m guessing this is the “orgy of fun” that was recently proposed.
I’m still hoping it’s an actual orgy. Though the idea of it lasting two full days like Uta suggested is mildly intimidating.
But if anyone is up to the task, it’s me.
I begin to slide off my shirt and-
: Um...Sensei?
: Now is probably not the best time...
: Fine. I’ll wait for someone else to go first.
: I can take the back seat every once in a while.
: So, Uta and I have been doing a lot of talking lately, and we think it might be good for us to have a little bonding exercise now that our class is finally full.
: That’s how it started, at least...
: Right. But in beginning to talk about different ways to bond, it quickly became apparent that there is a big point of contention between the two of us.
: Ayane thinks her floor is better than ours! And we must show her that she is wrong!
: Rise up, second floor! And Molly!
: I AM ON THAT FLOOR TOO!
scene thisiswar18
: I don’t know what gave Uta the idea that the second floor was better than the first, but I’m pretty sure it has something to do with finally being at a higher elevation than other girls her age.
: I’ll have you know that I am one whole inch taller than Sana. And sometimes one inch is all that matters.
: Isn’t that right, Sensei?
: I don’t think it would make that much of a difference for me.
: Heheh...
: Yes. You could lose one inch and still be taller than all of us.
: You are a large man.
: Thanks, Tsuneyo. That’s exactly what I was referring to.
: Anyway, the two of us thought it might be good to start a little...friendly competition to truly show everyone, once and for all, which floor is the better floor.
: And so! I will be the captain of my floor and Ayane will be the captain of-
scene thisiswar19
: Absolutely not!
: We’re going to have our next batch of standardized tests any day now. And you should know more than anyone how crucial it is to be studying at a time like this!
: Also, the first floor is clearly better and the fact that you think you can disprove that with a stupid contest is laughable.
: Hey now...I wouldn’t say laughable. There’s plenty of stuff our floor is better at.
: That may be true, but I absolutely will not support a contest to prove that.
scene thisiswar20
: Wow. That was pretty much word for word how you said she would react.
: Yeah. I was more or less prepared for this.
: Don’t make me sound like some sort of predictable-
scene thisiswar21
: You can be captain of the first floor, Makoto.
: It should be okay that way, right?
scene thisiswar22
: Sure! Why not?
: You already lead the classroom and you’re the student council president, so you definitely have the experience.
: Besides, we’re going to win either way, so it doesn’t really matter who the captain is.
: Well...I suppose it does sound like a good bonding experience. And the second floor could certainly use that given that they’re all still relatively new here.
: But...the winners would need to get something to make it worth while. Wouldn’t they?
: Otherwise, it’s just a waste of time and-
scene thisiswar23
: Oh, we’ve already decided on what the winner gets.
: And it’s a lot more than just bragging rights.
: That’s right, Ayane...In fact, it’s the most sought after award in the[school].
: S-Sought after?...
: Then...wouldn’t that mean...
scene thisiswar24
: THE WINNER GETS SENSEI!
: What?
: Is it too late to drop out of the contest?
: Yeah, I can sit this one out too. Give him to somebody else.
: What the fuck?
: Specifically, whichever floor wins will get to keep him in their room for the upcoming beach trip.
: So you better start packin’ your PJ’s now, Sensei. You’re gonna be with us second floor girls whether Otoha likes it or not.
scene thisiswar25
: Oooooh, that is a good reward.
: How do we win?! What do I do?! What is the dress code for the sleepover?!
: You can’t win.
: Us first floor girls have been with Sensei much longer than any of you.
: Sounds to me like somebody is forgetting I’ve been with Sensei longer than anyone except for like, Ami I guess.
: I don’t care if I have to carry the entire floor. I’m going to win and I’m going to get all up in his business at our swimsuit slumber party thingy.
scene thisiswar26
: Lay so much as a finger on him and you will die.
: Joke's on you. I'm perfectly content dying for that.
: You underestimate me, Chika.
scene thisiswar27
: Are you okay with these terms, Sensei?
: He’s okay with them as long as our floor wins and he gets to sleep in the bed with me.
: Better idea: What if all twenty-one of us just sleep in the same bed and-
: No can do, Sensei. I appreciate you openly admitting that you want to sleep in the bed with me, even though I’ve known it all along-
: But the show must go on and the combatants must be chosen.
: So please, here and now, surrender your rights and agree to room with whoever the winner of the contest is.
: I don’t really like calling it “surrendering my rights” but...if all that’s going to happen is me sleeping next to a bunch of girls, sure.
: Perfect!
: Now, please exit the room so we can figure out who is up against who and blah blah blah logistical stuff.
: You’re going to need the rest anyway, Sensei. These next two days are going to be action-packed, especially since you'll be acting as a judge for some of the competitions.
: I actually have to participate? I can’t just surrender myself and be done with it?
: Oh you’ll be participating, alright. This contest can’t exist without you.
: Now get the heck out of my classroom so me and Makoto can start whippin’ our girls into shape!
: I’m down to get whipped if Uta is offering. Sounds fun.
: I’ve never really looked at her like that, but I probably wouldn’t refuse if Makoto wanted to whip me as-
: No one is whipping anyone! But yes, Sensei, please vacate the premises.
: It appears that Uta and I have quite a bit to talk about...
scene black
Welcome to the first annual Super Mega Ultimate Dorm War!
The next two days will be completely filled with events featuring head to head battles between two girls from each floor.
Some events will have predetermined outcomes, but several of them have outcomes that you will be able to choose!
In the end, only one floor can be crowned as the winner!
So sit back, relax, and do the thing!
